summary: FAIL on one new Medium finding. The D-037 repairs for F-DG0-241, 242, 243 and 244 work, and I verified all four CLOSED_VERIFIED: the real-repo dry-run gate has 0 PRUNED/RECORD-LESS/DROPPED errors, and only round-not-finished artefacts remain; a present fix that is not in the candidate is still caught; off-branch and tag gate commits are rejected; record-less sidecars can neither close nor hide findings; every fix_revision is full 40-hex and either retained or genuinely pruned. However, the new commitPresent() tolerance is unscoped (F-DG0-245, Medium). A gate-round run whose meta head_commit_at_start is missing, null, 'unknown' or non-existent is accepted, which regresses round-9 QA5-N52/N53, and a non-existent fix_revision is accepted on a gate-round closure. The fix is small and feasible on the real history. All other required checks pass. The shell-level live write probe is BLOCKED by the permission classifier; the Write-tool guard probe passed.
